```python
import pygame
import snake_sim

# Initialize the game
game = snake_sim.Snake(3, 3, color = (0, 0, 0, 0))
game = game.display()

# Main game loop
while game:
    game = game.update()
    game = game.draw()
    game = game.display()

# Quit the game
game = game.quit()
```
